name: GAMUDA
recent: Gamuda 与合资伙伴在台湾获得价值 RM2.61b 的基隆捷运地下工程合约，同时 Gamuda Land 与 Taylor's Assets 合作开发学生住宿项目。公司近期也提交了 2026 年报、股东回购授权及股东大会通知，并有多名高管在闭门期内外进行股权交易。
notable: Gamuda 领导的合资公司获得台湾基隆捷运地下工程合约，价值 RM2.61b。
Gamuda Land 与 Taylor's Assets 合作开发学生住宿项目 Haus on 15。
公司发布 2026 年报及股东回购授权声明，并发出股东大会通知。
risks: 集团首席财务官 Soo Kok Wong 于 11 月 11 日以每股 RM4.90 脱售 383,800 股。
多名高管在闭门期内表示有意进行股票交易。
公司通过 ESOS 行使发行新股，最新股本增至约 60.65 亿股。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 7 月 31 日）营收 RM5.757b，净利 RM349.7m，净利率 6.1%。营收环比增长 29.8%，净利环比增长 35.6%；营收同比增长 18.9%，净利同比增长 5.3%。

recent_en: Gamuda, through a joint venture, secured a RM2.61b Keelung MRT underground project in Taiwan, while Gamuda Land partnered with Taylor's Assets for a student living development.
notable_en: Gamuda-led JV won the RM2.61b Keelung Underground MRT project in Taiwan.
Gamuda Land partnered with Taylor's Assets to develop the Haus on 15 student living project.
risks_en: Group CFO Soo Kok Wong disposed 383,800 shares at RM4.90 each on 11 Nov.
Several senior executives indicated intention to deal in shares during the closed period.
New shares were issued via ESOS exercise, raising the latest share capital to about 6.065 billion shares.
earnings_en: FY2026 (ended 31 July) revenue was RM5.757b with net income of RM349.7m and a net margin of 6.1%. Revenue rose 29.8% QoQ and net income 35.6% QoQ; revenue grew 18.9% YoY and net income 5.3% YoY.
